notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: This part has no reference mesh and no previous render, because it exists only in the revised configuration: in the previous one the Diff Gear Shaft's own 40T band is the pulley. Only the revised render is shown, drawn as an 80T GT2 ring bonded over the shaft's band, with the slip gap taken up by epoxy. The dimensions are in 720-004_DiffShaftPulley.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
